name: home-launcher
cmd: g=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir); sed "s/--remote-control '[^']*'/--remote-control 'program'/; s/^DYAD_SESSION='[^']*'\$/DYAD_SESSION='program'/; s#dyad-launched#dyad-launched-home#; s#'This session is the maintenance unit[^']*'#'Read your inbox: this session is the home of the dyad system installed here, and its first message is the configuration batch to ask.'#" "$g/dyad-launch" > "$g/dyad-launch-home" && chmod +x "$g/dyad-launch-home"
